a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice to reach 8, take in round 3) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. Please don't also take: if we both grab, the random split could leave us both short. After that I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take anything more.
